'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Afghanistan conflict (1978–present)|Afghanistan conflict]]
**[[Panjshir conflict]]
***The [[National Resistance Front of Afghanistan]] says that their fighters have killed eight [[Taliban]] members in clashes in the [[Panjshir Valley]], the final stronghold outside of Taliban control. A large number of Taliban forces have been deployed near the valley, while negotiations take place in order to resolve the conflict. [https://www.reuters.com/world/asia-pacific/eight-taliban-killed-panjshir-fighting-afghan-militia-forces-say-2021-08-31/ (Reuters)]
**Aftermath of the [[Withdrawal of United States troops from Afghanistan (2020–2021)|withdrawal of United States troops from Afghanistan]]
***Celebratory gunfire occurs in [[Kabul]] by Taliban fighters following the departure of the last aircraft carrying [[U.S. troops]]. Taliban spokesperson [[Zabihullah Mujahid]] says during a news conference that "it is a historical day and a historical moment" and that "the Taliban are proud of these moments, that we liberated our country from a great power." [https://www.reuters.com/world/india/rockets-fired-kabul-airport-us-troops-race-complete-evacuation-2021-08-30/ (Reuters)]
*[[Houthi–Saudi Arabian conflict]]
**A [[drone attack]] against the [[Abha International Airport]] in [[Abha]], [[Saudi Arabia]], injures eight people. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2021/8/31/several-wounded-drone-attack-saudi-airport-houthis-yemen (Al Jazeera)]
*[[Insurgency in Balochistan]], [[International military intervention against ISIL]]
**Eleven [[Islamic State of Iraq and the Levant|Islamic State]] militants are killed in a raid by [[Counter Terrorism Department (Pakistan)|Pakistani counter-terrorism units]] in [[Mastung District|Mastung]], [[Balochistan, Pakistan|Balochistan Province]], where ISIL militants had recently killed two police officers. Suicide belts, hand grenades and assault rifles are seized during the raid. [https://abcnews.go.com/International/wireStory/pakistan-11-islamic-state-militants-killed-raid-79740636 (AP via ABC News)]

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*[[2021 California wildfires]]
**[[California Department of Forestry and Fire Protection|California fire officials]] issue an evacuation order for the [[Lake Tahoe|Lake Tahoe Basin]] as the [[Caldor Fire]] continues to spread. The fire has burned 177,000 acres and destroyed over 470 structures so far. [https://www.cbsnews.com/news/caldor-fire-evacuations-lake-tahoe-basin-california/ (CBS News)]
**The [[United States Forest Service]] orders all [[List of national forests of the United States|national forests]] in [[California]] to be closed until mid-September in order to help combat the state's wildfires. [https://www.cbsnews.com/news/california-wildfires-national-forests-close-temporarily-crisis/ (CBS News)]
*[[2021 Atlantic hurricane season]]
**Two people are killed and 10 more are injured after a 50 [[Foot (unit)|foot]] section of [[Mississippi Highway 26]] collapses west of [[Lucedale, Mississippi]] due to [[Hurricane Ida]]. [https://www.cbsnews.com/news/hurricane-ida-highway-26-collapse-2-dead-10-injured/ (CBS News)]
*At least 32 people are killed and more than 20 others are wounded as a bus plummets from a cliff in [[Lima]], [[Peru]]. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2021/9/1/dozens-dead-as-bus-plunges-off-cliff-near-peruvian-capital-lima (Al Jazeera)]

'''Health and environment'''
*[[COVID-19 pandemic]]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Asia]]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Bangladesh]], [[COVID-19 vaccination in Bangladesh]]
****The [[Bangladesh Armed Forces]] receives a consignment of COVID-19 vaccines from China's [[People's Liberation Army]] for the first time as part of foreign military assistance. [https://www.unb.com.bd/m/category/Bangladesh/chinese-pla-provides-covid-19-vaccines-to-bangladesh-armed-forces/78105 (United News of Bangladesh)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Israel]]
****[[Israel]] reports a record 10,947 new cases of COVID-19 in the past 24 hours, thereby bringing the nationwide total of confirmed cases to 1,066,352. [https://www.israelhayom.com/2021/08/31/health-ministry-ups-restrictions-as-daily-covid-cases-spike-to-11000/ (''Israel Hayom'')]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Fiji]]
***The top medical adviser to the [[government of Fiji|government]] says that the vaccination of children between the ages of 12 and 17 years old is "crucial" in order to prevent more fatalities among children as Fiji has reported ten children dying from [[COVID-19]], most recently a six-month-old boy who was infected with the [[Delta variant]]. [https://www.rnz.co.nz/international/pacific-news/450390/covid-19-fiji-vaccinating-children-crucial-top-health-official (RNZ)]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in the Republic of Ireland]]
***The [[Government of the 33rd Dáil|Irish Cabinet]] approves a plan that would lift all COVID-19-related restrictions in [[Republic of Ireland|Ireland]] on October 22 subject to 90% of adults being [[COVID-19 vaccination in Ireland|vaccinated]] and the number of COVID-19 cases remaining manageable. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-europe-58400777 (BBC News)]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Morocco]], [[COVID-19 vaccination in Morocco]]
***[[Morocco]] begins a [[COVID-19 vaccination]] program for children aged 12 to 17 years old in an effort to ensure their return to schools. [https://www.africanews.com/2021/09/01/covid-19-morocco-begins-inoculating-children-over-12-years-old/ (Africanews)]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in the United States]]
***The U.S. surpasses 39 million cases of COVID-19. [https://www.kiro7.com/news/trending/coronavirus-total-us-covid-19-cases-top-39-million/D33EIJHQANGCPO73OJCT3R7PL4/ (KIRO-TV)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Georgia (U.S. state)|COVID-19 pandemic in Georgia]]
****[[Georgia (U.S. state)|Georgia]] reports a record 9,641 new cases of COVID-19 in the past 24 hours. [https://apnews.com/article/health-education-georgia-coronavirus-pandemic-9c47fd840f7777f563cadaf418f44cde (AP)] 
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Idaho]]
****[[Governor of Idaho|Idaho governor]] [[Brad Little]] activates and deploys the [[Idaho Military Department|Idaho National Guard]] to hospitals to stop the spread of COVID-19 cases in [[Idaho|the state]]. [https://www.idahostatesman.com/news/coronavirus/article253887338.html (''Idaho Statesman'')]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Pennsylvania]]
****[[Governor of Pennsylvania|Pennsylvania governor]] [[Tom Wolf]] announces a [[Face masks during the COVID-19 pandemic in the United States|mask mandate]] for [[Pennsylvania]] schools and daycares. The mandate will take effect on September 7. [https://www.cbsnews.com/news/covid19-pennsylvania-face-mask-requirement-students-k12-child-care-centers/ (CBS News)]
**[[Variants of SARS-CoV-2]]
***The [[World Health Organization]] designates scientifically-named B.1.621 variant, known as "Mu" and first detected in [[Colombia]], as variant of interest, amid concerns that it has mutations which suggest it is more resistant to [[COVID-19 vaccine|vaccine]]s. [https://www.telegraph.co.uk/global-health/science-and-disease/designates-new-mu-variant-interest/ (''The Daily Telegraph'')]

'''International relations'''
*[[Australia–Singapore relations]], [[COVID-19 vaccine]], [[International aid related to the COVID-19 pandemic]]
**[[Australia]] signs a vaccine swap agreement with [[Singapore]] that will allow it to receive 500,000 doses of the [[Pfizer–BioNTech COVID-19 vaccine]] from Singapore later this week. [https://www.forbes.com/sites/siladityaray/2021/08/31/australia-enters-vaccine-swap-agreement-with-singapore-amid-unrelenting-delta-variant-surge/ (''Forbes'')]
*[[Afghanistan–India relations]]
**The [[List of ambassadors and high commissioners of India|Indian ambassador to Qatar]] [[Embassy of India, Doha|Dr. Deepak Mittal]] meets with [[Taliban]] representative [[Sher Mohammad Abbas Stanikzai]] in [[Doha]] to discuss the [[repatriation]] of [[Indians in Afghanistan|Indian citizens who are currently in Afghanistan]]. [https://timesofindia.indiatimes.com/india/india-holds-first-dialogue-with-taliban-in-doha-return-of-indians-from-afghanistan-discussed/articleshow/85799628.cms (''Times of India'')]

'''Law and crime'''
*[[Capital punishment in Bangladesh]], [[LGBT rights in Bangladesh]]
**A [[Judiciary of Bangladesh|court in Bangladesh]] sentences six men affiliated with [[Ansar al-Islam in Kurdistan|Ansar al-Islam]], an organization linked to [[al-Qaeda]], to death, for the 2016 murders of two gay rights campaigners, including [[Xulhaz Mannan]]. Local gay and LGBT organizations welcome the verdict. [https://www.reuters.com/world/bangladesh-sentences-six-militants-death-killing-gay-activists-2021-08-31/ (Reuters)]
*[[Transgender rights in the United States]]
**Twenty [[U.S. state|U.S. states]], led by [[Tennessee]] [[Tennessee Attorney General|Attorney General]] [[Herbert Slatery]], file a lawsuit against the [[Presidency of Joe Biden|Biden administration]] in an attempt to halt new regulations put forth by the [[Equal Employment Opportunity Commission]] and the [[United States Department of Education]] promoting transgender rights in schools, alleging [[Balance of powers|federal overreach]]. [https://www.foxnews.com/politics/20-states-sue-biden-admin-biological-males-girls-sports-teams (Fox News)]
*[[Corruption in Peru]]
**The Peruvian judiciary kicks off a preliminary court hearing against [[Popular Force]] leader [[Keiko Fujimori]] to decide whether to prosecute her for money laundering and her involvement in the [[Odebrecht]] scandal. [https://rpp.pe/politica/judiciales/keiko-fujimori-inician-audiencia-que-la-enfrenta-a-mas-de-30-anos-de-prision-noticia-1355216 (RPP)]

'''Politics and elections'''
*[[2021 Estonian presidential election]]
**[[Alar Karis]] is elected [[President of Estonia]] by the [[Riigikogu]]. [https://news.err.ee/1608321953/alar-karis-elected-president-of-estonia (ERR)]

'''Science and technology'''
*A [[SpaceX Dragon 2]] from the [[List of International Space Station expeditions|re-supply mission]] [[SpaceX CRS-23]] successfully [[Docking and berthing of spacecraft|docks]] with the [[Harmony (ISS module)|''Harmony'' module]] of the [[International Space Station]], carrying 4,800 [[Pound (mass)|lbs.]] of supplies. [https://scitechdaily.com/spacex-cargo-dragon-successfully-docks-to-international-space-station/ (SciTechDaily)]
